hypothesis: Five mega-cap banks absorb this book at 10× its size with no change, so R=3.
why: type: realizability. BLOCKS the exit gate (realizability unset ⇒ blocked), and nothing else can set it. DECISION RULE: R=3 if the curve is bit-identical to base (max|Δcum| = 0) AND every name's min 20-bar median money over 2024 >= 8e7; R=2 if the floor bites (any LIQFLOOR out<in) but sharpe stays >= 1.0; R=1 is not reachable from this test.
